d:
Gulshan Kumar and T-Series presents Bhushan Kumar's "Taaron Ke Shehar" sung by Neha Kakkar and Jubin Nautiyal. The song depicts a tale of an intense love story followed by pain and separation featuring Neha Kakkar & Sunny Kaushal. The song is composed and penned by Jaani.
